type ElementOf<T> = T[][number];
interface List<T> {
  [n: number]: T;
}
function viaArray<T extends T[][number]>() {}
function viaGeneric<T extends Array<T>[number]>() {}
function viaReadonly<T extends ReadonlyArray<T>[number]>() {}
function viaTuple<T extends [T][number]>() {}
function viaPair<T extends [T, string][number]>() {}
function viaLiteral<T extends T[][0]>() {}
function viaRest<T extends [string, ...T[]][3]>() {}
function viaOptional<T extends [T?][number]>() {}
function viaInterface<T extends List<T>[number]>() {}
function viaRecord<T extends Record<string, T>['x']>() {}
function viaUnionObject<T extends (T[] | string)[number]>() {}
function viaUnionKey<T extends [T][number | 0]>() {}
function viaNested<T extends T[][][number][number]>() {}
function viaAlias<T extends ElementOf<T>>(x: T) {
  return x;
}
function viaArrayElement<T extends T[][][number]>() {}
function viaFixedRest<T extends [T, ...string[]][3]>() {}
function viaLength<T extends T[]['length']>() {}
function viaSecond<T extends [T, string][1]>() {}
console.log(viaAlias(2));
